tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Accent: Slider thumb and track fill, ThroughputGraph series, hyperlinks. #0078d6 is the library default; applications normally supply the Windows accent. In the high-contrast theme it is the consumer accent (yellow).

tokens.name: accentHover
tokens.usage: Accent on hover. Derived: Oklab L +8% of `accent` (RefreshAccentVariants).

tokens.name: accentPressed
tokens.usage: Accent while pressed. Derived: Oklab L −12% (light) / +16% (dark bases) of `accent`.

tokens.name: windowBackground
tokens.usage: Root page and host background. Ground for `text`, `subduedText`.

tokens.name: surfaceBackground
tokens.usage: Tiles, panels and popups sitting on `windowBackground`.

tokens.name: cardBackground
tokens.usage: CardPanel fill. Equals `surfaceBackground` in every built-in palette.

tokens.name: overlayBackground
tokens.usage: Menus, ComboBox popups and PopupLayer fill (Solid material).

tokens.name: overlayBorder
tokens.usage: Hairline around overlays. Equals `borderDefault`.

tokens.name: smokeOverlay
tokens.usage: Scrim behind modal overlays (30% black; 46% in dark).

tokens.name: headerBackground
tokens.usage: Grid column headers, MenuBar, TabControl strip.

tokens.name: headerHovered
tokens.usage: Header cell / tab under the pointer.

tokens.name: headerPressed
tokens.usage: Header cell / tab while pressed.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: General 1 DIP control and panel outline. Source value misses 3:1 on `windowBackground` (1.8:1 light) — kept exact; focus chrome carries the accessible boundary.

tokens.name: gridLine
tokens.usage: Grid and Tree row / column separators.

tokens.name: borderDefault
tokens.usage: Default hairline for cards, overlays and separators.

tokens.name: borderStrong
tokens.usage: Emphasised divider (splitter grip, strong separators). 2.3:1 light, 3.3:1 dark.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary text on `windowBackground`, `surfaceBackground`, `buttonFill`, `inputFill`.

tokens.name: subduedText
tokens.usage: Secondary text: captions, tile labels, units, accelerators. 5.5:1+ on `surfaceBackground` in every theme.

tokens.name: disabledText
tokens.usage: Text of disabled controls. Intentionally below 4.5:1 (3.0:1 light) — disabled text is exempt from WCAG contrast.

tokens.name: selectionFill
tokens.usage: Selected Grid / Tree rows, checked Checkbox / Radio, focused ComboBox item. Carries `selectionText`.

tokens.name: selectionText
tokens.usage: Text and glyphs on `selectionFill` (4.5:1 light, 5.4:1 dark, 10.8:1 high contrast).

tokens.name: selectionInactiveFill
tokens.usage: Selected row when its control does not have focus (45% light / 55% dark alpha; opaque in high contrast).

tokens.name: toggleKnobFill
tokens.usage: Toggle knob when off.

tokens.name: toggleKnobCheckedFill
tokens.usage: Toggle knob when on (sits on `selectionFill`).

tokens.name: focusStroke
tokens.usage: Focused TextField border and the tint source for `hoverFill` / `pressedFill`.

tokens.name: hoverFill
tokens.usage: Translucent row and menu-item hover wash.

tokens.name: pressedFill
tokens.usage: Translucent row and menu-item pressed wash.

tokens.name: focusStrokeOuter
tokens.usage: Outer keyboard focus ring (2 DIP, 2 DIP outside the control). 17:1+ on every ground.

tokens.name: focusStrokeInner
tokens.usage: Inner keyboard focus ring (1 DIP, 1 DIP outside the control), separating the outer ring from the control.

tokens.name: buttonFill
tokens.usage: Standard Button rest fill; ground for `text`.

tokens.name: buttonBorder
tokens.usage: Standard Button 1 DIP outline (source value; below 3:1, see `border`).

tokens.name: buttonHotFill
tokens.usage: Button fill on hover (140 ms blend).

tokens.name: buttonPressedFill
tokens.usage: Button fill while pressed; caption shifts 1,1 DIP.

tokens.name: buttonPrimaryFill
tokens.usage: Primary Button fill = Blend(buttonFill, selectionFill, 90/255 light · 110/255 dark); exact selection pair in high contrast.

tokens.name: buttonPrimaryText
tokens.usage: Primary Button caption: `selectionText` when it reaches 4.5:1 on `buttonPrimaryFill`, else `text` (so dark text in light).

tokens.name: buttonDisabledFill
tokens.usage: Disabled Button fill = Blend(windowBackground, buttonFill, 0.58 light · 0.72 dark); caption in `disabledText`.

tokens.name: inputFill
tokens.usage: TextField, ComboBox, NumericStepper field fill; ground for `text`.

tokens.name: inputBorder
tokens.usage: Input field 1 DIP outline at rest; hover blends it toward `focusStroke`, focus replaces it.

tokens.name: scrollbarTrack
tokens.usage: Scrollbar track (12 DIP thick).

tokens.name: scrollbarThumb
tokens.usage: Scrollbar thumb at rest (radius 4, min 20 DIP).

tokens.name: scrollbarThumbHot
tokens.usage: Scrollbar thumb under the pointer or dragging.

tokens.name: tooltipBackground
tokens.usage: TooltipLayer fill — inverted against the theme (dark tooltip in light, light in dark).

tokens.name: tooltipText
tokens.usage: Tooltip text on `tooltipBackground` (15:1+).

tokens.name: infoFill
tokens.usage: Informational badge / status background. Consumer-supplied (ThemeColors.alertInfo*) in app themes; shown as `windowBackground` in high contrast.

tokens.name: infoText
tokens.usage: Text on `infoFill` (5.3:1 light, 8.7:1 dark).

tokens.name: warningFill
tokens.usage: Warning badge / status background. Consumer-supplied in app themes.

tokens.name: warningText
tokens.usage: Text on `warningFill` (4.6:1 light, 8.3:1 dark).

tokens.name: errorFill
tokens.usage: Error badge / status background. Consumer-supplied in app themes.

tokens.name: errorText
tokens.usage: Text on `errorFill` (6.0:1 light, 9.4:1 dark).

families.text: "Segoe UI Variable Text", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif
families.small: "Segoe UI Variable Small", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif
families.display: "Segoe UI Variable Display", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif

styles.name: Display
styles.usage: FontRole::Display — hero numerals and splash titles only.

styles.name: Title
styles.usage: FontRole::Title — section titles. Line height comes from DirectWrite metrics.

styles.name: BodyStrong
styles.usage: FontRole::BodyStrong — RadioButtons group caption, emphasised labels.

styles.name: Body
styles.usage: FontRole::Body — the default for every control caption and label.

styles.name: ListItem
styles.usage: FontRole::ListItem — Grid, Tree and menu rows. ≤12 DIP selects Segoe UI Variable Small.

styles.name: Small
styles.usage: FontRole::Small — caption equivalent: accelerators, badges, units.

styles.name: Monospace
styles.usage: FontRole::Monospace — hex values, code, aligned numerics.

styles.name: Icon
styles.usage: FontRole::Icon — inline chevrons, checks, clear buttons.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Tooltip horizontal padding, MenuBar item padding (standard).

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Tab header padding, multiline Button horizontal padding, slider inset.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Tree indent, menu accelerator gap and right padding, badge padding.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Gallery sheet margin; PageHost enter slide distance.

tokens.usage: Menu slider stops.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Default: Button, TextField, ComboBox (Window/Edit), Checkbox box, inline CardPanel, tooltip, menus, popups, menu item hover, scrollbar thumb.

tokens.name: radius-tab
tokens.usage: Tab headers and TagPicker tags.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Selector Button variant, Modern ComboBox.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Overlay cards and the toggle row background (7 when compact).

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Toggle track (half its 20 DIP height).

shadow.note: CSS renditions of the Direct2D shadow effect (Controls.cpp PaintShadow): blur, y offset and opacity copied; D2D blur standard deviation differs slightly from CSS blur radius.

tokens.name: shadow-menu
tokens.usage: Context menus and MenuBar drop-downs, Solid material.

tokens.name: shadow-popup

tokens.name: shadow-menu-acrylic
tokens.usage: Menus over Acrylic material.

tokens.name: shadow-popup-acrylic
tokens.usage: ComboBox popup over Acrylic material.

size.note: Control metrics in DIPs, from the k…Dip constants.

tokens.name: menubar-height
tokens.usage: MenuBar (24 compact).

tokens.name: checkbox-size
tokens.usage: Checkbox indicator; toggle knob box.

tokens.name: radio-size
tokens.usage: RadioButton circle; slider chrome disc; PageIndicator strip.

tokens.name: toggle-track-width
tokens.usage: Toggle track width (20 tall).

tokens.name: scrollbar-thickness
tokens.usage: Scrollbars.

tokens.name: splitter-thickness
tokens.usage: Splitter bar; slider track thickness.

tokens.name: progress-track
tokens.usage: Determinate ProgressBar track (4 when indeterminate).

tokens.name: touch-row
tokens.usage: Minimum popup item height for touch (SetMinimumPopupItemHeight) and slider hit band.

tokens.name: stroke-hairline
tokens.usage: Every control outline (DrawRoundedRect), separators, menu separators.

tokens.usage: Outer focus ring width, drawn 2 DIP outside the control in `focusStrokeOuter`.

tokens.name: focus-inner-width
tokens.usage: Inner focus ring width, drawn 1 DIP outside the control in `focusStrokeInner`.

tokens.name: focus-offset
tokens.usage: Distance of the outer ring from the control bounds; corner radius grows by the same amount.
